name: Dranik Heartlands
summary: The central plains of Dranik, scarred by war and patrolled by Muramite forces.
description: The Dranik Heartlands were once fertile plains and sacred Dragorn homelands. After the Muramite invasion, the Heartlands became a war‑torn expanse of ruined settlements, corrupted fields, and fortified Muramite encampments. Dragorn resistance fighters operate in scattered pockets, striking from hidden shelters. Discord energy bleeds into the land from nearby ruptures, warping wildlife and destabilizing ancient Dragorn structures. The Heartlands serve as the primary battleground between Muramite occupiers and Dragorn rebels.
